figures.short_alt_en: Open Jingzhang overview map and spatial protocol
figures.long_description_en: A horizontal overview links the Zhongzhiyuan Build yard, AI Origin Review yard, and Dazhongsi Merge yard along one Living Mainline. It also identifies two public switches, outward branches, the provisional boundary, and the evidence status.

figures.short_alt_en: Three-level scope and topology-safe land-use structure
figures.long_description_en: The figure shows how seven conceptual land-use classes are produced from the same provisional site through ordered differences, and how Build, Review, and Merge complement everyday urban functions. It does not represent approved land use.
reading_order_en: Functional relationships among the three areas

figures.short_alt_zh: 三区公共验证线与场景14六步人物空间旅程

figures.long_description_zh: 图上部用 Living Mainline 串联众智园 Build、AI 原点 Review 和大钟寺 Merge；中部把城市议题路由台展开为普通入口、提问门槛、人工前台与去标识、Branch 桌、Human Review、公开回执与退出恢复六个空间时刻，每步均列同任务非 AI 路径和人工闸门；底部说明红牌、独立申诉及待确认的场地和实施边界。
reading_order: 场景14六步人物空间旅程
同任务非AI路径与人工闸门

figures.short_alt_en: Three-yard public proof line and six-moment Scenario 14 journey
figures.long_description_en: The upper band links Zhongzhiyuan Build, AI Origin Review and Dazhongsi Merge along the Living Mainline. The middle band expands the Civic Issue Router into six spatial moments—ordinary arrival, question threshold, staffed de-identification, Branch desk, Human Review, and public receipt with exit restoration—each with a same-task non-AI route and a human gate. The lower band records red-card authority, independent appeal and pending site and delivery conditions.
reading_order_en: Same-task non-AI route and human gates

figures.short_alt_en: Mobility, walking, blue-green, and public-space coordination diagram
figures.long_description_en: The figure relates the Living Mainline walking spine, three area loops, public switches, green space, and public space. All routes are conceptual and do not replace road redlines, railway engineering, or waterway blue lines.

figures.short_alt_zh: 空间指标、合成桌面复演与首百日证据闸门
figures.short_alt_en: Spatial metrics, synthetic tabletop replay, and first-100-days gates
figures.long_description_zh: 图上部列出场地、绿地、公共空间和概念建筑基底四项约数；中部显示7个合成fixtures由contract—fixtures—runner—human gate—receipts链确定性复演，结果为1 PASS、5 HOLD、1 RETIRED，并覆盖删除、回滚、恢复和公开回执；底部把8项尚未开始的首100天证据行动分为四个时窗，所有现实条件仍待确认。
reading_order: 删除、回滚、恢复和公开回执
现场未运行和待确认边界

figures.short_alt_en: Spatial metrics, synthetic tabletop replay, and first-100-days gates
figures.long_description_en: The upper row lists four rounded spatial metrics. The middle shows seven synthetic fixtures replayed deterministically through contract–fixtures–runner–human gate–receipts, producing one PASS, five HOLD and one RETIRED, with deletion, rollback, restoration and public-receipt evidence. The lower row groups eight not-started first-100-days evidence actions into four windows; all real-world conditions remain pending.
reading_order_en: Deletion, rollback, restoration and public receipt
No field run and pending conditions

figures.long_description_zh: 合成概念封面以蓝调鸟瞰走廊为背景，金色 Build、珊瑚色 Review 与青绿色 Merge 三类公共节点沿发光双轨串联。画面表达 Living Mainline 的设计意图，不是实景、官方规划效果图、测量成果或建设状态。
figures.long_description_en: A synthetic blue-hour aerial corridor links gold Build, coral Review, and teal Merge public nodes along a luminous double track. It expresses the Living Mainline concept and is not a site photograph, official planning rendering, surveyed geometry, or built status.
